text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-M-04, Stainless Steel Baudrillard Cabinet Door Pull

The Brushed Stainless Steel Baudrillard Pull is simple with a subtle unique detail that elevates it from the ordinary to something more interesting. The groove in the mounts provide depth. Made out of stainless steel, the Baudrillard Cabinet Pull has a brushed stainless steel finish, for a beautiful, modern look.

Also Available Matching Baudrillard Cabinet Knob

Specifications of the Brushed Stainless Steel Baudrillard Cabinet Pull:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Center to Center: 4"
  • Overall Length: 4-9/16"
  • Height: 15/32"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
